settings.eyebrow: The Jade Kettle Tea House · Loose-leaf · Hand-brewed
settings.headline: Tea that asks you to slow down.
settings.copy: The Jade Kettle is a tea house tucked into the corner of the Marble Arcade — no espresso machine, no music, no hurry. We source single-origin leaves from small estates, brew each pot to the right temperature for the leaf, and pour it for people who want somewhere to be present for a while.

trust_list.text: Single-origin leaves from nine small estates, bought whole leaf
Every pot brewed to a temperature matched to the leaf
A quiet room with soft light, no laptops on the tea tables
Leaf-to-cup service — watch it steep, pour when it's ready

settings.title: Leaf,
settings.intro: A living list that rotates with the harvests. Each tea is chosen whole-leaf, bought in small lots, and brewed to bring out what the estate intended — never bagged, never over-steeped.

items.name: Jade Cloud Green
items.description: A high-mountain green from Anji, China — sweet, nutty, and almost creamy, with a pale jade liquor. Brewed cool, at 70°C, for a soft finish.

items.name: Midnight Oolong
items.description: A dark, roasted Tieguanyin with notes of cocoa, stone fruit, and a long, toasty tail. We brew it hot and fast to keep the roast alive.

items.name: Silver Needle White
items.description: A delicate Fuding white made from unopened buds — honeyed, floral, and endlessly patient. Brewed gently; refills are free while the leaf lasts.

items.name: Hojicha & Milk
items.description: A warm, low-caffeine house blend of roasted green hojicha and steamed milk, lightly sweetened with raw cane. Comfort in a cup.

items.name: Earl of the Fog
items.description: Our take on a classic: Assam with a whisper of bergamot, brewed strong enough to stand up to a splash of milk.

items.name: Kettle Tasting Flight
items.description: Three small pots from three corners of the world, chosen by our brewers each day, poured in order with a note card for each.

settings.title: The
settings.intro: A pot at the Jade Kettle follows the same quiet path every time — a ritual we protect because it makes the tea taste better.

steps.title: Choose the leaf
steps.text: Tell us how you're feeling or what you like; our brewers will point you to the leaf that fits the moment. Everything is on the list for a reason.

steps.title: Heat the water right
steps.text: Each leaf has a temperature it likes — greens cool, oolongs hot. We heat to the degree, never guess.

steps.title: Rinse & awaken
steps.text: A quick rinse opens the leaves and shakes off the dust of travel, so the first true steep starts clean.

steps.title: Steep, then pour
steps.text: We steep to the clock and pour when it's ready — not a second over. Most leaves give several good infusions; we'll guide you through them.

steps.title: Sit with it
steps.text: The pot sits on a warm stand, the room goes quiet, and you take your time. This is the whole point.

settings.note: Laptops and loud calls live at the long table by the window; the low tea tables are reserved for drinking.

settings.title: A house built on
settings.intro: Anyone can boil water. We think it deserves more care than that — here's what we refuse to compromise on.

features.title: Whole-leaf, bought direct
features.text: We buy whole leaves in small lots from estates we've met, never commodity dust. It costs more and tastes the difference.

features.title: Temperature, not guesswork
features.text: Our kettles heat to a precise degree for every leaf — a green at 70°C is a different tea than the same leaf at 90.

features.title: Multiple infusions, always
features.text: Good leaves steep more than once. We pour every good infusion, not just the first, and refill is part of the pot.

features.title: A room that honors silence
features.text: Soft light, warm wood, and a no-rush rule. It's a place to read, to talk quietly, or simply to sit.

features.title: Brewers, not baristas
features.text: Our team trains on provenance and brewing technique, not latte art. Ask them anything about a leaf — they'll talk all day.

features.title: Tea you can take home
features.text: Every leaf on the list is sold loose by weight to go, so the ritual doesn't have to end at the door.

settings.title: The kettle
settings.intro: People find their table, their leaf, and their ritual. Here's what a few of them say after years of sittings.

reviews.quote: I come here to write, but I stay because the tea is the quietest, best-tended in the city. The brewers remember your leaf from one visit to the next. That's rare.
reviews.author: Sofia Reyes

reviews.quote: The Jade Cloud Green at 70 degrees is the best cup of tea I've ever had, and I've had a lot. They treat the leaf like it matters, because it does.
reviews.author: Tomas Hargrove

reviews.quote: No laptops at the low tables, no rush, no soundtrack. Just warm light and a pot that keeps giving. It's the one place in the arcade I actually relax.
reviews.author: Meera Patel

settings.title: Come in,
settings.intro: We're on the ground floor of the Marble Arcade, past the bookshop, left at the fountain. The door is open from mid-morning to early evening, every day.
